column1: # Red probes for the shared guards: each neuters ONE guard in a copy and names the case that must
# then fail. tests/red.sh runs them. Tab-separated: id, file (relative to the guards dir), the
# literal to replace ({NL} is a newline), the case that must go red (a regex over the FAIL line),
# the replacement (empty means a string that matches nothing) and the case files to run.
# A product adds its own probes in the same shape (GUARD_PRODUCT_PROBES, files relative to the product root).
